question: Consider the function $f(x)=|\sin x|+|\cos x|$ defined for $x$ in the interval $(0,2\pi)$. Then

options.B: $f(x)$ is not differentiable at $x=\frac\pi2$ and $\frac{3\pi}2$ and differentiable everywhere else
options.C: $f(x)$ is not differentiable at $x=\frac\pi2,\ \pi$ and $\frac{3\pi}2$ and differentiable everywhere else
options.D: none of the foregoing statements is true

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level
